records.text: An Alliance air-force alarm bot deployed across Outland zones. Its name and dedicated bot script identify a mechanical warning role; the supplied evidence does not establish how its alarm works.

Nazgrel is Thrall's advisor and the Horde expedition's self-appointed safeguard in Hellfire Peninsula. He directs the response to fel-orc threats, including an assassination plot against the Falcon Watch envoy, and sends word of the Mag'har to Thrall. As the campaign reveals the fel orcs' use of a pit lord's blood, he urges a strike against their military power. He treats Kargath Bladefist's threat to Thrallmar as a priority and calls for the Horde to rise against the remaining fel orcs.

The Winter Reveler is a shared Winter Veil host, offering seasonal wishes of peace and holiday cheer. The reveler also responds to mistletoe with a knowing greeting, matching the festive, playful role.

Far Seer Regulkut, the Warchief's seer at Thrallmar, speaks for the orc expedition whose journey is a return to ancestral roots. She turns to spiritual insight when ordinary tracking fails, sending a wolf spirit to find someone by their essence. She is also concerned that her promising student Grelag studies history while overlooking present dangers, and has gone missing near Spinebreaker Post amid the Legion and fel orcs.

Shadow Hunter Ty'jin, the Warchief's ears at Thrallmar, directs a campaign against the Fel Horde. He describes its troops as brutal, battle-hardened and strengthened by foul magic, with Shattered Hand legionnaires, centurions and champions serving as a feared officer corps. Ty'jin calls their elimination the first step toward an assault on the Horde's leadership.

Overlord Hun Maimfist, the Warchief's hand at Thrallmar, urges visitors to stand ready for duty. After their flight, he says Nazgrel has a new use for them and suspects the Legion is only getting started. His words present him as a direct commander who expects Thrallmar's allies to return to the fight.

Martik Tor'seldori speaks from experience of Outland, recalling its abundant arcane power with the fervor of someone who has tasted a promised paradise. He recruits allies for Falcon Watch, the sin'dorei outpost, and warns that Alliance scouts heavily patrol the road there. His advice to travel with blood elves mixes practical caution with a preference for his own people.

The Blood Elf Pilgrim is part of the audience listening to Martik's account of Outland. The pilgrims prompt him to explain the experience and react with a gasp as he describes its overwhelming arcane abundance.
A sentinel of Falcon Watch.
Thrallmar grunts discuss firing toward Honor Hold and argue over who should cut the rope, with one pointing out that the other has the knife.
A marksman of Thrallmar.

Rohok is Thrallmar's master blacksmithing trainer, concerned with forging blades and spears for the battlefield and irritated when Nazgrel instead requests work on a key. Rohok nevertheless attempts the commission, acknowledging fel orc craftsmanship and insisting on fel iron for the mold. When ordinary coals cannot provide enough heat, Rohok recalls a fallen fel reaver's blazing interior and recommends bringing friends to defeat one and temper the key there.

Watch Commander Krunk oversees Thrallmar’s defenses, assigning peons to reinforce and repair the walls as the Legion’s assaults threaten the settlement. He presses them to work with a sharp, impatient admonition and says he cannot spare guards for the mine while the town remains under attack.

Cookie One-Eye serves food and drink in Thrallmar, calling diners to collect their slop. His service comes with a blunt warning: complain to Nazgrel and he threatens to serve one of the garrison’s diners as the next meal.
Huntsman Torf Angerhoof is Thrallmar’s stable master. He offers pet stabling and help recovering lost companions.
Barley serves as a wind rider master in Thrallmar, offering flight routes. When attacked, he calls for guards and summons an enraged wyvern.

Apothecary Antonivich studies fel magic and the corruption of Hellfire Peninsula's orcs. He uses the Demoniac Scryer to analyze that magic, though its trapped intelligence demands Shattered Hand souls before it will serve. His investigation draws Thrallmar's leadership into the effort, and he reports findings to the Royal Apothecary Society so the orcs can be protected from future corruption.

Guard Captain Cragtar remembers leading a battalion on what began as routine reconnaissance along the Bone Road. After his scout spotted orcs, Cragtar's soldiers approached, only to find enormous red orcs unlike any they had seen. The encounter cost him some of his best soldiers; he is left uncertain how to make sense of it.

An injured Thrallmar grunt speaks from the perspective of a wounded soldier, with a painfully upset stomach and little patience for the food he has been given. He recognizes Cookie's cooking and jokes about its spices, then asks his chief what kind of orcs they are facing.
A Thrallmar peon found in Hellfire Peninsula, among the outpost’s worker population.
The Eye of Thrallmar is a beast found on Hellfire Peninsula.
A Thrallmar wolf rider present in Hellfire Peninsula. A mounted rider associated with the outpost.
A riding wolf associated with Thrallmar and found in Hellfire Peninsula.
Floyd Pinkus keeps an inn, offering comfort and a place he calls home. He also deals in goods for travelers. His welcome is warmly phrased, with a teasing appeal to rein in a guest’s savage impulse.

Ranger Captain Venn'ren is working to keep Falcon Watch’s Sin'dorei pilgrims moving despite Alliance pressure. He devised a concealed route through the Great Fissure, first thinning the rock flayer population and then marking the way with beacons. As Alliance forces militarize draenei ruins, he is also willing to spare help for the troll outpost at Swamprat Post.

Falconer Drenna Riverwind helps keep Falcon Watch’s rangers supplied, gathering feathers for their arrows when she can. She is also trying to breed trainable kaliri, which means finding and raising a female hatchling. Drenna redirects requests she considers minor to the Cenarion Post rather than bother Venn'ren, and remarks that Hellfire’s barrenness is a sharp change from Eversong’s forests and grasslands.

Ryathen the Somber works to keep Hellfire Peninsula's felblood supply available to the blood elves. He sends people to gather felblood from the terrorfiends at the Pools of Aggonar and seeks to stop the draenei from cleansing the pools, which would end that supply. His concern is practical and strategic: he sees the demonic power in Outland as something to harness and master.

Arcanist Calesthris Dawnstar studies Outland's magic and seeks knowledge held by the Haal'eshi arakkoa. She asks for their magical scrolls, believing their ancient arcane knowledge will aid blood elf exploration. Her enthusiasm for Outland's magical energy is tied to a larger hope: that the sin'dorei will make the world their new home and master its power.

Magistrix Carinda is a blood elf at Falcon Watch whose worry over her missing husband Arelion turns to anger when his journal reveals an affair with Viera Sunwhisper. She questions his confidant and arranges retribution against Viera. In private, she speaks affectionately to Twinkle, fears being left alone, and tells the pet that Arelion will not return.

Apothecary Azethen is a Forsaken researcher at Falcon Watch who tests the theory that fel exposure caused draenei to become Broken and Lost Ones. He obtains demonic essences for experiments on a captive draenei, whom he threatens when ordering him to drink a concoction. Azethen jokes that his friendship with the Sunstriders gained him access to Outland research subjects.
The Draenei Prisoner is Azethen’s captive test subject, held for experiments into fel corruption. He addresses his Forsaken captor with pity and condemns him as devoid of the Light.

Amaan the Wise is a blind draenei whose sight is not needed to perceive what matters. He seeks to cleanse the Pools of Aggonar, once sacred springs fouled by demonic blood, and believes they can be restored to purity. He also sends others to recover Sha'naar relics, trusting that patience brings clarity. In reflecting on Sedai's death, he treats the relic's vision as a likely account rather than certain truth and urges openness to what may come.

Scout Vanura asks for help protecting the Broken who fled to Outland from violence. At the Great Fissure, rock flayers prey on these displaced draenei, so she assigns the grim task of thinning their numbers. She regrets having to kill even dangerous beasts and thanks those who carry out the work.
Provisioner Anir is a draenei food and drink vendor who offers supplies and assistance to visitors.

Ikan is a Broken who found guidance among the Omenai after the orcs’ demonic magic left his people confused and vulnerable. He works to free Broken captured by Illidan’s allies and guide returning Dreghoods in their old ways. His cousin was eaten by Blacktalon, and he seeks proof of the matriarch’s death as revenge.

Force Commander Danath Trollbane leads the Sons of Lothar and commands Honor Hold. He welcomes new heroes to a force worn down by two decades of war on Hellfire Peninsula. Determined not to yield to the orcs, he advocates taking the fight to Hellfire Citadel. He weighs Warp-Scryer Kryv’s warnings about the Legionlord Arazzius and calls for allies to confront that threat.

Lieutenant Amadi is a Sons of Lothar officer stationed near Honor Hold. She investigates the rising fel orc threat and is concerned by their growing presence near the Southern Rampart; a scout she sent to investigate has not returned.
Magus Filinthus is a humanoid magus in Hellfire Peninsula.
Krill Bitterhue is a gryphon master who arranges flight travel. During an attack, he calls for the guards’ help.
Humphry is a master blacksmithing trainer in Hellfire Peninsula, with training and goods services. He keeps an eye on the mines, asking newcomers whether they bring news.
Master Sergeant Lorin Thalmerok is Honor Hold’s stable master. He helps travelers stable their pets and recover lost companions.

Father Malgor Devidicus is a priest who served beside Turalyon for many years. Before their departure, Malgor gave him Mysteries of the Light; Turalyon read from it daily to his men and later returned it. Malgor calls the book his only remaining token of Turalyon and remembers their comradeship as closer than family.

Sid Limbardi is Honor Hold’s innkeeper, selling goods and offering travelers a hearth there. He hired the Longbeard brothers to stop arakkoa raids on supply caravans. Their choice to pack more ale than food or ammunition worries him, and he asks someone to check on them.

Honor Guard Wesilow is troubled by the spirits of his former comrades, who were cursed at the Expedition Armory and trapped between life and death. He says the surviving men find the memories too painful to approach the ruins, and fears the ghosts may become increasingly malevolent. He seeks help freeing them and suspects their leaders' spirits may be tied to the rest.
Honor Guard Greyn is an Honor Guard.

Magus Zabraxis is an ambitious researcher eager to test fel embers, whose power she thinks should not be ignored. She describes her work as cutting-edge research and admits it is risky enough that she must keep it secret from those who would forbid it. She asks for a fel ember to study and is wary of an expected reporter, directing other visitors to her reagent supplies.

Field Commander Romus reveres Danath Trollbane and was overcome with emotion when he found him alive in Outland. He is committed to keeping the Sons of Lothar safe and directs efforts against the Shattered Hand officer corps, viewing its defeat as a first step against the Fel Horde leadership.
A Nethergarde infantry soldier, a humanoid found in Hellfire Peninsula.
Prospector Murantus is an Explorers' League prospector in Honor Hold who directs workers toward the surrounding ruins, inviting those looking for work to take a pick and dig.

Makuru grieves Sedai, whom he regarded as a brother, and demands vengeance for his death from the Mag'har. He offers his only possession, a gift from Sedai, in return for vengeance; his grief also breaks through in fragmented speech.

Anchorite Obadei is Sedai's brother and mourns him after learning of his death. He shares Makuru's grief but rejects vengeance as contrary to Sedai's ideals and their people's ways, and points toward Amaan the Wise for guidance.
An archaeologist of the Explorers' League.
An escaped Dreghood in Hellfire Peninsula.

Foreman Biggums is responsible for the mine and its workers at Honor Hold. He is anxious to drive the gan'arg from the tunnels: they have driven his miners out and threaten the mine's work, while Danath is pressuring him to resolve the trouble. Biggums looks for help and believes the infestation has a deeper leader.
Honor Hold miners are workers associated with the stronghold's mining operation in Hellfire Peninsula.

Warp-Scryer Kryv is a draenei spiritual leader at Honor Hold who seeks to give proper rest to his people’s tortured dead along the Path of Glory. He asks for help cleansing the bones used to pave it, and takes comfort when some souls are released. He also interprets a demonic missive and warns of the Legion’s growing threat.
A defender of Honor Hold in Hellfire Peninsula.
Honor Hold Cavalrymen are cavalry soldiers.

Gorkan Bloodfist is a Mag'har captain at Mag'har Post. News that the Mag'har have returned to Azeroth moves him to send word to Hellscream at once. Though cautious with strangers near the Citadel, he permits a visitor to speak because Ryga sensed the spirits with them. He welcomes aid for his people and says it will not be forgotten.
A Mag'har grunt serving among the tribe in Hellfire Peninsula, this rank-and-file warrior is built for combat: when badly wounded, the grunt becomes enraged and uses Frenzy.

A weakened Mag'har grunt near Mag'har Post, this individual responds to Ryga's healing salve with relief: its strength is returning, it recognizes the cure, and it thanks the healer, saying it is in their debt. Its words show a fighting spirit eager to return against the tribe's enemies.
Provisioner Braknar is a Mag'har provisioner at Mag'har Post. He greets visitors with the clan-minded “Strength to the Clans,” then directly asks what brings them to the post.

Gremni Longbeard is the elder of the dwarf brothers hired to stop arakkoa raids on supply caravans. He says he and Mirren were sent by Honor Hold to deal with the arakkoa, but the nearby quillfang ravagers have made their work difficult. He calls the brothers world-famous marksmen, while admitting that birdmen who wield lightning are outside their usual hunting trade. He welcomes help against both threats and celebrates success with a drink.

Mirren Longbeard is one of the dwarf brothers camped with Gremni near the Den of Haal'esh. He says the arakkoa killed one of their own, leaving him wary of strangers, and asks for proof of loyalty to Honor Hold before offering a deal. Ale is a welcome bargaining point: he offers his own distinctive hat for kaliri feathers, and insists the brothers are keeping their beer to themselves. When a bargain is fulfilled, he acknowledges it and hands over the promised hat.
Caretaker Dilandrus was born in this graveyard, where his parents are buried. Though he once longed to leave, he remains to honor his family, the Sons of Lothar.

Grelag is Far Seer Regulkut’s promising student, eager to study his people’s history but careless about present dangers. While traveling to study Zeth’Gor’s ruins, he was wounded by the Legion and rescued by Stone Guard Ambelan. He needs a salve for his injured leg and plans to return to Thrallmar once it has dulled the pain.
A Deranged Helboar is a demonic creature that can enter a frenzy.
A Stormwind infantry soldier serving in the fighting in Outland.
An injured Stormwind infantry soldier in the Outland campaign.
An injured Nethergarde infantry soldier in the Outland campaign.
A Shattered Hand grunt among the fel orcs attacking Honor Hold.
A Shattered Hand captain in the fighting around Outland. Their rank sets them apart from the grunts.

A Bleeding Hollow grunt serves among the force opposing Honor Hold. Its battle cries threaten intruders and invoke Spinebreaker, while its combat behavior includes striking and becoming enraged. It is a rank-and-file fighter.
A Bleeding Hollow dark shaman fights as part of the force at Spinebreaker. Its cries threaten intruders and enemies, invoke Spinebreaker, and warn that their bones will be devoured.

A Bonechewer mutant is a hostile fighter that invokes Spinebreaker and warns enemies that their bones will be devoured. It also calls for the Warchief to be protected. It can become unstable and begin to disintegrate.
A Shattered Hand berserker belongs to the force ordered to form the western flank of an attack on Honor Hold. It charges enemies on aggro and can become enraged in combat.
A starving helboar is an animal whose designation describes its hungry condition rather than identifying a named individual.

Hulking Helboars are aggressive boars under study by Cenarion researchers. Thiah Redmane asks travelers to test an antidote on one, hoping that removing its demonic influence will reduce its aggression and help explain how Outland’s corruption might be treated.
A war horse, a beast.

Amythiel Mistwalker serves the Cenarion Circle as a nearby emissary at Cenarion Post. She receives warnings about naga activity and helps relay the Circle’s support and volunteers toward Ysiel Windsinger’s Cenarion Expedition at Cenarion Refuge.

Arator the Redeemer says he knew his father only through other people’s accounts, since his father was sent to Outland when Arator was an infant. A recurring dream leaves him kneeling beside a crushed man he believes is his father as the Legion battles nearby; he cannot make out the dying man’s words.
The Eye of Honor Hold is a beast found on Hellfire Peninsula.

Mahuram Stouthoof asks for help keeping the route through Thornfang Hill open. Increasingly aggressive ravager attacks threaten to cut the Cenarion outposts off from Cenarion Refuge in Zangarmarsh; he wants travelers protected while avoiding displacing the creatures where possible.
An archer serving with Honor Hold.

A foul slime spawned by the fel-tainted waters of the Pools of Aggonar, where demon blood corrupted the sacred springs. Blistering Rots are among the beings travelers are asked to destroy so the pools can be reclaimed.
Blistering Oozeling may carry Arelion's Journal. Arelion had been studying slimes at the Pools of Aggonar before he went missing; the journal is sought as a record of that work.

An Unyielding Footman is one of the Expedition Armory's former defenders, cursed by the Horde's Death Knights and trapped between life and death. Its soul shares the torment of the other defenders there, including sorcerers and knights.

Unyielding Sorcerers are among the Expedition Armory defenders cursed by the Horde's Death Knights, with their souls trapped between life and death. Honor Guard Wesilow calls them his former comrades and asks that their torment be ended.

Unyielding Knights are among the Expedition Armory defenders cursed by the Horde's Death Knights, with their souls trapped between life and death. Wesilow calls them former comrades; in combat, a knight charges an attacker.
Bleeding Hollow Peons fight as hostile troops: their cries threaten intruders and invoke Spinebreaker, and a badly wounded peon may flee for help.
Mag'har Watchers are humanoid combatants. They cast Lightning Shield and, when badly wounded, Healing Wave.
Mag'har Hunters are humanoid combatants who summon a tamed ravager while out of combat.

Foreman Razelcraz is a stranded miner from Booty Bay, where his cousin Screed Luckheed left him in Outland. He resents the fel orcs who steal his shredder parts and peons, and depends on a pack of biting, unreliable felhounds to guard his camp. He keeps trying to repair the shredder, earn enough to go home, and leave Outland; his impatience with the machine comes through in his muttering.
A Bonechewer raider fights for Spinebreaker and treats outsiders as enemies, calling for their deaths and threatening to devour their bones. It joins battle on a riding wolf.

A young Stonescythe rock flayer found around the Great Fissure and nearby areas. Blood elves regard these beasts as a danger to their planned secret route and hunt them; when badly hurt, a whelp defends itself desperately.
The Stonescythe Ambusher fights in desperation when hurt, using a defensive response called Desperate Defense. Its cry frames the move as an effort to protect itself under pressure.

Ranger Captain Venn'ren regards the rock flayers as brutal beasts threatening his proposed secret path through the Great Fissure, and includes Stonescythe Alphas among the creatures he wants killed. In combat, an Alpha uses Tear Armor and turns to desperate defense when wounded.
The Razorfang Hatchling is a young Razorfang creature that uses Ravage in combat.
The Razorfang Ravager uses Ravage in combat.
The Quillfang Ravager attacks with Corrosive Mist when it fights.
The Dreghood Geomancer uses Fireball in combat.

Dreghood brutes suffer under demonic coercion, asking to be put out of their misery and seeking forgiveness because they have no choice. Their obedience is resentful and qualified as lasting only for now.
A Mo'arg forgefiend demon whose combat repertoire includes Saw Blade and Slime Spray.

Gan'arg servants are demons under Razorsaw at Forge Camp: Mageddon. Forward Commander Brock targets them to disrupt what his intelligence describes as a Legion fel reaver production camp still under construction.
A netherhound demon whose combat attacks include Mana Burn.

Terrorfiends are demons spawned by the fel-tainted blood at the Pools of Aggonar, once a site of sacred springs. Arazzius the Cruel has gathered a force of them nearby. In combat, a Terrorfiend uses Fel Flames and War Stomp.

A Forge Camp Legionnaire is one of the Legion's forces at Forge Camp: Rage, where its minions work on an unknown project northeast of Thrallmar. Horde scouts sent to investigate the camps have not returned, so the Horde now orders a direct assault to uncover the Legion's plans. The Legionnaire is one of the camp's targets during that push.
A Dread Tactician is an elite demon who takes the field with Carrion Swarm and Sleep, combining an attack with magic that can put enemies to sleep.

A Sister of Grief is a demon among the targets at Forge Camp: Rage. The Horde sends fighters into the camps after repeated bombardment of Thrallmar and the loss of scouts, and she is one of the targets in that assault. In battle, she uses Lash of Pain and Whipped Fury.
The plans identify Warlord Morkh as Zeth'Gor's leader and the mastermind behind attacks led by Bone Magus Warlor; his forces are part of a wider assault on Honor Hold or Thrallmar.
Haal'eshi Windwalkers are arakkoa in the Den of Haal'esh, where Gremni Longbeard describes attacks on Honor Hold patrols. They wield lightning magic, using Lightning Bolt and Hurricane in combat.
Haal'eshi Talonguards are arakkoa in the Den of Haal'esh, where Gremni Longbeard describes attacks on Honor Hold patrols. A Talonguard sprints when engaged and may flee for help when badly wounded.
Tunneler is a hostile creature.
A Rogue Voidwalker is a voidwalker encountered in combat; this one attacks with Shadowstrike.
An Uncontrolled Voidwalker is a voidwalker encountered in combat and uses Shadowstrike.

Ghostly Denizens voice fear over relentless attacks and anger at being unable to leave their homes. Some demand answers from a Lieutenant; one speaker mourns son Thalvos and a spouse. Their reactions include sobbing and anger.
Arch Mage Xintor is a ghostly leader remembered as particularly close to his men.

Lieutenant Commander Thalvos was a leader especially close to his men. His ghost is among those haunting the Expedition Armory, where he urges people to settle down as they struggle to control the situation and fend off relentless orcs.

Thiah Redmane is a Cenarion Expedition researcher studying Outland’s dangerous, continually mutating wildlife. She collects helboar blood samples to document the changes and investigate their cause. She experiments with an antidote derived from toxins, hoping to curb the creatures’ demonic influence; when it backfires on a helboar, her surprise gives way to curiosity about Outland’s peculiarities and a resolve to share the result with her comrades.

This blood elf set out from Thrallmar ahead of her group despite Martik Tor'seldori's warning, then was attacked by ravagers, captured by bird-men, and locked in a cave. Injured and short of strength, she is trying to reach Falcon Watch; on arrival, she realizes her pack is missing.

Angela “The Claw” Kestrel is deeply affectionate toward her unusually small felhunter, Jir'see, cooing to him and calling him her little angel. She believes she can help him grow and seeks warp hound blood for an experimental treatment.

Jir'see is Angela Kestrel's pet felhunter, much smaller than the others, according to Angela. She dotes on him and hopes a treatment she is preparing will help him grow; her quest calls for warp hound blood for the experiment.

Elsaana studies voidwalker magic and argues that blood elves misuse it to feed their addiction. She has prepared a crystal intended to neutralize a voidwalker and sever its link to this world. After the test, she says the containment crystal is holding for now and that she will keep watch while preparing more.
A voidwalker demon, this creature can unleash fear in combat and collapses as it nears death or dies.

At Falcon Watch, Taleris Dawngazer coordinates care for blood elf pilgrims and prepares them for the long journey. With space limited, he is firm with Gal'ressa after she has had time to recover, urging her back onto the road and warning that keeping her there means turning other travelers away.
A kaliri matriarch, this beast defends itself in combat with a forceful wing buffet.
A young male kaliri, this hatchling uses a swooping attack when fighting.

Pilgrim Gal'ressa is exhausted by the rigors of traveling through Outland and resents Taleris pressuring her to leave before she has recovered. She refuses to travel alone, plans to wait for the next group of pilgrims, and angrily tells Taleris to stop bullying her.
Rumatu at the Temple of Sha'naar is expected to invoke the Light against a demon using a Glowing Sanctified Crystal.
The Kaliri Swooper is a creature whose combat behavior includes attacking with a swooping strike.

Blacktalon the Savage is a rock-flayer matriarch described in quest notices as vicious and sought in a cave in the Great Fissure. Two requests seek her claws as proof of her death. One hunter says Blacktalon ate his cousin and wants revenge; in combat, she tears armor.

At the Ruins of Sha’naar, this Illidari taskmaster drives captured Dreghood to dig and threatens them with pain if they slow or disobey. He seeks the Ata’mal crystal for his master and orders the laborers to fight intruders, showing how he uses the enslaved Broken to protect that search.
Aeranas identifies Avruu as the Haal’eshi mage who trapped him in the orb. In combat Avruu uses Judgement of Darkness and can cast Dark Mending on a friendly target.

Aeranas says he once ruled the eastern winds and that the Haal’eshi mage Avruu trapped him in an orb. He bargains for freedom, then says Avruu’s magic still controls him and asks to be fought to break the spell. Afterward he declares himself free and offers a reward to settle the debt.

Earthcaller Ryga tends sick Mag’har grunts at Mag’har Post, seeking drycap mushroom to make a healing salve after contaminated water sickens them. She says the Mag’har must keep their location secret, so she cannot search herself; she asks for help finding the ingredient and administering the salve. She thanks helpers and says the Mag’har are in their debt.

Viera Sunwhisper is on pilgrimage and admits she misses good wine, even joking she would kill for Cenarion spirits despite their night elf brewing. She invites a companion to share a bottle privately. During an encounter with Twinkle, she tries to flee, then panics and demands the cat be taken away. Her greeting to strangers is guarded and brusque.
Jia is a named beast found on Hellfire Peninsula.
Blackbeak is a named beast found on Hellfire Peninsula.
A recovering pilgrim in Hellfire Peninsula.
Provisioner Valine offers food and drink, with a vendor menu inviting visitors to browse her goods.
A humanoid ranger associated with Falcon Watch.
Yaluu is present in Hellfire Peninsula.
Anchorite Alendar is an anchorite in Hellfire Peninsula.

Gunny is a blunt, abrasive military officer at Honor Hold who treats visitors as recruits to be tested, insulting civilians and demanding that people prove they belong in Outland. She directs assignments against the fel orcs of Hellfire Citadel, expects reports and evidence, and mocks failure in the same cutting, sarcastic style she uses to praise success. Her dialogue shows impatience with delays and a hard focus on the fight facing the garrison.
Stone Guard Stok'ton is a Thrallmar officer who briefs you on the assault against Hellfire Citadel's fel-orc leaders and directs you to bring proof of their defeat to Caza'rez.
Lieutenant Chadwick briefs Honor Hold's operation against the fel orcs at Hellfire Citadel, directing you to defeat its leaders and bring proof to Gunny.

Caza'rez is a Thrallmar officer investigating the fel orcs of Hellfire Citadel. He seeks blood samples from the Blood Furnace to learn how the new fel orcs are made, and orders a full investigation there because his scrying detects an unnatural disturbance.
Quartermaster Urgronn manages Thrallmar supplies. He welcomes visitors and offers access to more of the faction's stock as they continue aiding its cause.
Logistics Officer Ulrike is Honor Hold's quartermaster, granting access to different stocked goods as a buyer rises in rank among its forces.

Warrant Officer Tracy Proudwell coordinates Honor Hold's effort to secure forward staging areas against Hellfire Citadel and redeems marks. Tracy hopes renewed aid from Azeroth will break a long, bloody stalemate, and warns that Horde forces also seek the Overlook, the Stadium and Broken Hill. Successful field service is praised as instrumental to the campaign.

Battlecryer Blackeye is a Thrallmar battle herald coordinating the Horde campaign against Hellfire Citadel. He directs fighters to seize three Alliance-contested staging forts and redeems their marks.
Mekthorg the Wild is a rare fighter encountered in Hellfire Peninsula. He launches Pike Vault in combat and can enrage when badly wounded.
Fulgorge is a rare creature encountered in Hellfire Peninsula. It rises from a submerged state to ambush nearby targets and poisons those within reach.
Vorakem Doomspeaker is the Herald of Doom Lord Kazzak. In battle, he uses Hamstring and Flame Wave, and can become enraged.

Doom Lord Kazzak remembers his defeat at the end of the Third War and has waited for revenge. He sees the Legion's return as the beginning of the world's undoing, and declares that it will conquer all and eradicate life.
Krugosh is a master mining trainer in Outland.
Ruak Stronghorn is a master herbalism trainer in Outland who offers herbalism instruction.
Dalinna is a master tailoring trainer. Her greeting asks whether a visitor has honed their skills enough to learn, and she also offers goods for browsing.
Kalaen is a master jewelcrafting trainer who offers instruction and goods for browsing.
Zebig is a master engineering trainer. His greeting asks whether visitors have honed their skills enough for his lessons; he also offers training and goods for browsing.
Felannia is a master enchanting trainer. She offers training and goods for browsing, while her greeting asks whether visitors have honed their skills enough for the lessons offered.
Barim Spilthoof is a master leatherworking trainer. His greeting asks whether visitors have honed their skills enough for his lessons; he offers training and goods for browsing.
Moorutu is a master skinning trainer who offers instruction in skinning.
A protector of Telhamat in Hellfire Peninsula.
Brumman is a master leatherworking trainer. His conversation offers training and goods, with a question about honing your skills before he teaches.
Hama is a master tailoring trainer. Her conversation offers training and goods, with a question about honing your skills before she teaches.
Johan Barnes is a master enchanting trainer. His records identify his craft and trainer role; the shared conversation menu offers training and goods.
Tatiana is a master jewelcrafting trainer. Her records identify her craft and trainer role; the shared conversation menu offers training and goods.
Lebowski is a master engineering trainer. His conversation offers training and goods, with a question about honing your skills before he teaches.
Rorelien is a master herbalism trainer.
Jelena Nightsky is a master skinning trainer who offers instruction in skinning.
Hurnak Grimmord is a master mining trainer who offers instruction in mining.
Kuma is a hippogryph master who offers the flight service, asking travelers where they would like to fly.

Alchemist Gribble is a master alchemy trainer who describes his knowledge as broad but general. He directs aspiring specialists to Lauranna Thar'well for potions, Lorokeem for elixirs, or Zarevhi for transmutation, and offers training and goods.

A Gan'arg Sapper is one of the demonic troublemakers overrunning the mine and threatening Thrallmar's ore supply. As it nears death, its eyes glow red and it cackles; when badly wounded, it can unleash Power Burn.
Bazil Olof'tazun is an innkeeper offering what shelter he can in the shattered lands. Visitors may ask to make the inn their home or browse his goods.
Caregiver Ophera Windfury is an innkeeper offering a place to sit and make oneself comfortable. Her supplied greeting is welcoming; no further personal history is established.

Vlagga Freyfeather is a Horde wind rider master who arranges flights, including passage between the Stair of Destiny and Thrallmar. She reflects that Outland is unlike the stories she had heard and wonders whether her people ever thrived in its desolation. She treats a report delivery as urgent business amid the Legion's pressure.

Amish Wildhammer is a gryphon master who arranges flights between the Stair of Destiny and Honor Hold. He sees Outland as nearing annihilation and doubts anyone survived there since the end of the Second War. When a report must reach Honor Hold, he offers a fast, safe gryphon flight.
Innalia is a wind rider master who offers flight-route guidance. Her greeting asks where a traveler would like to fly, and she can call guards and summon an enraged wyvern when attacked.
The Pit Commander is a pit creature.
Stormwind Soldiers are Stormwind-affiliated combatants found in Outland.
The Stormwind Mage is a Stormwind-affiliated mage combatant found in Outland.
Orgrimmar Grunts are Orgrimmar-affiliated combatants found in Outland.

Bonechewer Scavengers are hostile combatants who threaten interlopers, fight for Spinebreaker, and boast of devouring their enemies' bones. Their calls mark them as Bonechewer fighters with a menacing, predatory manner.
A Darnassian archer is a combatant.

Justinius the Harbinger rallies Azeroth's soldiers against the Burning Legion and Kazzak's forces, urging them to hold the line and defend their world. He speaks with solemn pride of fighting beside his allies, accepts the possibility of dying among them, and invokes the Light while praising the Alliance.

Melgromm Highmountain rallies hunters and calls them his comrades-in-arms, framing their fight against the Burning Legion as a battle for Azeroth. He says the spirits sing of battle and urges his companions to stand firm even if they die. He states that he must gather and direct Horde forces; his recorded combat abilities include Chain Lightning and Earth Shock.
Darkspear axe throwers patrol the area and enter combat when engaged.
This Undercity mage is stationed in the area as a combatant.
Orgrimmar shamans patrol the area and fight when engaged.

Z'kral is a named combatant in the mine beneath Honor Hold. Foreman Biggums's quest identifies him as the suspected force directing the gan'arg incursion and calls for his death; Z'kral fights with Drill and Power Burn.

Wrathguards are demons guarding Legion encampments along the Legion Front east of Reaver's Fall. Forward Commander To'arch orders their elimination as part of an assault on the demons operating there; a wrathguard uses Flame Wave in combat.

Urga'zz directs the workers in Thrallmar's mine, urging them to work faster and crack stone. Foremen Razelcraz's accounts identify him as the gan'arg leader deep in the mine, whose presence keeps the workers and machinery out of reach. In combat, Urga'zz uses Drill and Power Burn.
A felguard destroyer is a powerful demon encountered in the Hellfire Peninsula region. This one is trained for close combat and uses Mortal Strike against its foes.
A fel sprite found around Hellfire Citadel.
Doomwhisperer is a demonic creature found in Hellfire Citadel. It attacks with a Draining Bolt.
Ironforge Paladins are armed Alliance troops found at the shattered halls of Hellfire Citadel.
Gaston is a chef who teaches cooking and sells goods. His menu offers both training and shopping, while his teaching prompt addresses a visitor whose skills are ready for further instruction.
Baxter is a chef who offers cooking instruction and goods. His teaching prompt asks whether a visitor has honed their skills enough to learn from him.
Burko is a medic who provides training, including talent and pet-skill services. The training options also include dual talent specialization and unlearning talents.
Aresella is a medic.
Fallesh Sunfallow is a weapon merchant. He invites customers to browse and says he has what they need if they have the money.
Lursa Sunfallow sells reagents. She invites customers to look around and tell her if anything interests them.
Talaara is a weapon merchant who offers weapon and armor repairs. She invites customers to take their time looking over the weapons.

Vodesiin is a reagent merchant who offers supplies for spellcasting. His greeting promises the item a visitor needs for a spell, presenting him as a practical source of magical components rather than a teacher or spell trainer.
The Wrath Master is an elite creature encountered in Outland.
This Silvermoon Magister is a blood elf spellcaster who channels arcane magic.
The Gnomeregan Conjuror is a spellcaster who channels arcane magic.

A Flamewaker Imp is one of the Burning Legion's minions stationed with other forces in Felspark Ravine. Sergeant Shatterskull's local campaign targets these troops as part of the effort against the Legion's ground commanders. The imps hold their position outside combat, though they can move when fighting.

Raging Colossi are mountain giants encountered around Fallen Sky Ridge. They appeared in the area after a huge red crystal fell nearby and an earthquake followed; Cenarion Post investigator Tola'thion says the colossi were not there before. He treats the giants as an immediate danger while investigating the crystal's strange energy. A colossus can become enraged and knock down opponents in combat.
A beast known as the Quillfang Skitterer that attacks with Ravage once in combat.
A demon handler of the Legion Front, where fel handlers move between Legion encampments. Wrathguards guard the camps, and a shivan subjugator oversees the operation.

Arazzius is identified as one of Kazzak's lieutenants and commander of the Legion ground forces in Hellfire. His combat taunts call challengers insolent and outmatched; on defeat, he admits failure to his master.
A demon known as the Mistress of Doom, she fights with Rain of Chaos and summons imps as her health falls.

Commander Duron commands at the Dark Portal in Hellfire Peninsula and directs newly arrived soldiers toward Honor Hold. He says the troops on the portal platform can hold against the Legion for now, but Honor Hold needs help more urgently. His report carries the situation to Marshal Isildor, and he urges reinforcements to move out without delay.

Lieutenant General Orion commands forces at the Dark Portal. He says the Legion has cut the Expedition off from its comrades, though his forces can hold the line with Alliance help. He sends a report through Vlagga Freyfeather to General Krakork, seeking support to drive the demons back.

General Krakork commands the Horde at Thrallmar and speaks bluntly about the war's poor prospects. He warns his soldiers against charging Legion kill squads and admits the Horde is losing ground. If he receives Orion's report, he fears Orion's forces may be overrun and says he will rally troops to help. He expects soldiers in this wasteland to use their wits to survive.

Sergeant Shatterskull serves Thrallmar at the supply caravan outside its southern wall. He studies Legion tactics to understand the demons' purpose and sees the Legion as the Expedition's greatest threat. He directs attacks against dreadlords and their forces in Felspark Ravine, then passes along orders to report to Forward Commander To'arch at Reaver's Fall.

Arcanist Torseldori is an arcanist in the Blasted Lands. She is a quest giver and a combatant who casts Frostbolt. When engaged, she urgently calls for the defenders to stop attackers and focus their fire.
Bloodmages in Hellfire Peninsula can cast Frostbolt and Frost Nova in combat.
Infernal Invaders are Dreadcaller's Minions found in the Blasted Lands. They are infernal creatures serving a Dreadcaller.

Infernal Warbringers are infernals found in several areas of the Blasted Lands. They are counted among the Burning Legion troops stationed at Felspark Ravine and are targets in the campaign against the Legion's ground forces.

Warboss Nekrogg commands fel orc patrols along the ramparts. Orders bearing his signature direct them to take both human and orcish prisoners south for interrogation. He is based in a tower, and a disturbance at its banner is expected to draw him out to confront the troublemaker.

Force-Commander Gorax leads the fel orcs in Hellfire Peninsula, with Drillmaster Zurok serving as his right hand. Gorax kept the defenders on the defensive for a long time. His command center stands at the end of the Path of Glory, near the citadel walls and Northern Rampart.
Scout Makha is an orcish scout held captive by fel orcs at their camp. Her rescue plan targets Warboss Nekrogg; his key is needed to open her cage.

Private Imarion is a human soldier captured by fel orcs and held in a cage. Orders bearing Warboss Nekrogg's signature direct the patrols to take their human prisoner south for interrogation, indicating his captors intend to keep him alive.

Forward Commander To'arch directs resistance against the Burning Legion from Reaver's Fall, assigning operations against its gateways, portals, production camps and communications network. He equips soldiers with primers or explosives for these missions and sends them to Wing Commander Brack for wyvern flights. To'arch praises successful work and jokes that insulting the Legion's god could spare a captive from torture.
Subjugator Shi'aziv is a shivan demon overseeing operations at the Legion Front. Fel handlers move between the encampments under Shi'aziv's oversight, while wrathguards defend them.

Tola’thion is a druid of the Cenarion Expedition at the Cenarion Post, where he is concerned with the mountain giants newly roaming Fallen Sky Ridge. He favors dealing with the immediate threat directly and is skeptical that investigating the crystal is as urgent as stopping the colossi. Galandria Nightbreeze regards him as slow to investigate and says he sends others into danger; their differing priorities put her investigation at odds with his practical focus.

Earthbinder Galandria Nightbreeze is an earthbinder of the Cenarion Expedition at the Cenarion Post, intent on uncovering the mystery of the crystal on Fallen Sky Ridge. She is eager to examine a shard and believes its evil emanations are driving the colossi mad. Her concern extends to the damaged land: she proposes using natural forces to heal it, and reacts with anger when she learns Kael’thas is behind the crystal’s effects.
A Shattered Hand grenadier encountered in Hellfire Peninsula. In combat, it throws dynamite, marking its role as a battlefield explosive specialist.

Warbringer Arix'Amal commands the Legion's Invasion Point: Annihilator and holds the key used to activate its portal. Thrallmar's orders identify him as the target to defeat in an effort to close the gateway.
Deathwhisperer is a high-ranking humanoid combatant encountered in Hellfire Peninsula. It uses Mind Flay, a mental attack.

Marshal Isildor is an Alliance marshal at Honor Hold, where he sees the campaign against the Legion as a war that must be fought for every scrap of Outland. He is stoic but unsparing about its cost, speaking of soldiers returning in body bags and demanding attention to the danger. He warns that demons fight with savagery and cunning, and that ordinary rules of war will not suffice.

Sergeant Altumus monitors the Burning Legion near Honor Hold’s eastern supply caravan. She sees the Legion’s activity as a serious escalation and identifies its dreadlord lieutenants at the Path of Anguish as the source of infernal storms. Her orders focus on disrupting those commanders and their forces; when high command redirects a capable soldier, she sends them east to Expedition Point.

Forward Commander Kingston directs operations against the Legion front from Expedition Point. He assigns missions to destroy demonic portals and transport gateways, then sends successful agents onward to Shatter Point. His briefings stress the danger and the need to survive, while completed missions earn his emphatic approval.

Drillmaster Zurok is the Shattered Hand fel orc singled out as leader of the force assembling near Hellfire Citadel. Alliance command orders his elimination to disrupt a force that appears to be preparing an assault; in combat, he uses a whirlwind and a close-range knock-away.
Supply Officer Shandria sells general goods, food, and ammunition, and repairs equipment. These services make her a practical supply contact at the Hellfire Peninsula outpost.
Supply Officer Isabel offers general goods and equipment repairs. Her posted guidance stresses repairing and stocking up before venturing into Hellfire Peninsula's harsh terrain.

Field Marshal Rohamus commands Alliance soldiers at Expedition Point. He orders them to dismantle a fel reaver and ship it to Stormwind, then proposes melting it into weapons. His remarks show fierce hostility toward the Legion and contempt for the Horde, with a competitive pride in Alliance strength.

Stone Guard Ambelan is a watchful figure at Spinebreaker Post, warning visitors to keep their voices low and their eyes open because enemies surround the outpost. He is involved in its response to the fel orc offensive: instructions for several operations direct adventurers to report to him at Spinebreaker Post after acting against forces at Zeth’Gor. He also helped Grelag, finding the injured scout and bringing him to the post.

Subjugator Yalqiz is a shivan subjugator at the Legion Front, singled out by Expedition Point’s commander as a target within the Legion’s guarded encampment operation. In combat, Yalqiz casts Pain Spike and uses Mind Sear when its health falls within a middle range.

Legassi is a chef among the survivors of the zeppelin crash at the Crash. Hungry himself, he jokes about being a starving cook and looks for local ingredients to feed the group. He grumbles about Screed’s rough landing and boasts, then improvises with a purification mixture to make helboar meat useful. Legassi treats cooking as a way to lift spirits, offering to share a meal with those who help gather ingredients.

Thornfang Ravagers inhabit Thornfang Hill in Hellfire Peninsula, where their increasingly aggressive attacks threaten travelers using the pass toward Zangarmarsh. Their combat training includes Ravage.

Thornfang Venomspitters inhabit Thornfang Hill in Hellfire Peninsula alongside the ravagers. Their increasingly aggressive attacks threaten travelers using the pass toward Zangarmarsh, and they fight with venom spit.

Arzeth the Merciless, servant of the Betrayer, drives the Broken at Sha'naar to search for an Ata'mal crystal. He demands relentless labor, watches for further escapes, and insists that his Master’s goal cannot fail. Naladu warns that Arzeth wanders nearby.

Naladu was once Naladu the Keeper of Earth, and betrayed the Dreghood elders for promises of power. Held by the Illidari for his knowledge of ancient draenei crystals, he helps free his people and restore their spirits. He plans to remain apart from the tribe, hoping to die in peace and that another of his brothers will serve the earth spirit.
Sergeant Dalton is a named sergeant in Hellfire Peninsula.

“Screaming” Screed Luckheed is a goblin zeppelin pilot stranded at the crash site. He asks for help gathering scattered parts and voidwalker essence to repair the craft and adapt its engine. He speaks as a resourceful, confident engineer, eager to improve the design once his crew can get away; he also regrets taking a shortcut through dangerous skies.

Watch Commander Leonus commands a watch in Hellfire Peninsula. His warnings call for cover when the area comes under attack and identify infernals falling on the courtyard, urging defenders to clear it and take shelter.

A Mo'arg Overseer is a Legion demon deployed at the Abyssal Shelf. Wing Commander Brack's sortie targets these overseers alongside Gan'arg Peons and Fel Cannons to keep pressure on Legion forces there.

A Gan'arg Peon is a Legion demon deployed in numbers at the Abyssal Shelf. Wing Commander Brack's aerial sorties target peons alongside Mo'arg Overseers and Fel Cannons to keep pressure on the Legion forces there.

A Fel Cannon is a Legion war machine deployed at the Abyssal Shelf. Wing Commander Brack's aerial sorties target these cannons alongside Gan'arg Peons and Mo'arg Overseers to keep pressure on Legion forces there.
A fel reaver sentry is a heavy mechanical combatant stationed in Hellfire Peninsula. It is a construct that attacks intruders.

Wing Commander Brack is a Horde flight officer at Reaver's Fall, overseeing air strikes against the Legion on the Abyssal Shelf. He offers windrider flights and bombing sorties, and presses for repeated attacks to keep the demons from strengthening their hold. His dialogue also refers to fleet business and flight missions.
A Maiden of Pain is a demonic combatant found in Hellfire Peninsula. It lashes enemies with Lash of Pain and works itself into a Whipped Frenzy while out of combat.

Wing Commander Dabir'ee is a flight officer at Expedition Point, coordinating gryphon strikes against the Bleeding Hollow stronghold at Zeth'Gor. He sends ground agents to mark its four towers for bombing and offers gryphon transport, including flights to Shatter Point.
A Shattered Hand neophyte is a junior combatant found in Hellfire Peninsula. It is a humanoid and uses Bloodlust when fighting.

A Shattered Hand warlock among the fel orc forces around Hellfire Citadel and the Path of Glory. The plans recovered by Honor Hold identify these forces as preparing a western-flank attack, while this warlock's own recorded routine includes maintaining Demon Armor outside combat.

A Shattered Hand mage serving among the fel orc forces around Hellfire Citadel. Mages of this rank are present in the force's occupied areas near Honor Hold; the available evidence gives no individual allegiance or dealings beyond that military role.

A Shattered Hand guard serving in the fel orc force near Honor Hold. The recovered plans identify the guards among the troops assigned to the western flank of a planned pincer attack. This guard strikes opponents in combat.
A Shattered Hand acolyte in the fel orc force near Honor Hold, counted among the troops assigned to the western flank in the recovered attack plans. In combat, this acolyte uses Mind Flay.

A Bleeding Hollow necrolyte stationed at Zeth'Gor, among the forces whose attack plans threaten Honor Hold. In combat, this spellcaster uses Fireball and cries, “For Spinebreaker!” alongside threats against intruders and their bones. The cry signals allegiance to Spinebreaker, though the evidence does not establish this necrolyte's personal history or knowledge of the wider plan.
A Bleeding Hollow worg found with the Bleeding Hollow force at Zeth'Gor. The supplied evidence identifies it as an animal and gives no further individual behavior or relationship.
A Bleeding Hollow Tormentor who fights for Spinebreaker and threatens intruders; it uses fear in combat.
An Orgrimmar Peon present in Hellfire Peninsula.
A Peon Overseer present in Hellfire Peninsula.
An injured grunt present in Hellfire Peninsula.
A Dreadcaller, described as one of the Burning Legion dreadlords commanding troops in Hellfire Peninsula. It moves in combat and casts Shadow Bolt when attacked.
Dark Cleric Malod offers healing and sustenance in Hellfire Peninsula and sells goods to visitors.
Supply Master Broog is a supply vendor in Hellfire Peninsula. He sells goods and provides repairs.
An Eye of Grillok is a hostile creature that alerts observers when it spots them.
Worg Master Kruush is a named worg master in Zeth'Gor. In combat he calls for his worgs and can become enraged; a wanted notice describes him as the leader of Bleeding Hollow worg riders.
Tagar Spinebreaker is a named creature encountered at Spinebreaker Post.
Peasant Worker is a generic creature type found in the Spinebreaker Post area.
Wounded Soldier is a wounded soldier creature found in the Spinebreaker Post area.
An Operations Officer in Hellfire Peninsula.

Brother Daniels is a priest whose prayers ask the Light to guide the fallen from darkness and death into truth and immortality. He also asks for strength and offers a blessing that the Light remain with others.
Quartermaster Gorman is a rations quartermaster who offers goods for browsing. His service centers on provisions.
Quartermaster Drake handles supplies and offers goods for browsing. He also provides repairs.
Nurse Judith is a named nurse.

Grillok "Darkeye" leads the Bonechewers at Zeth'Gor into battle and makes his lair in a cave beneath the outpost. Battle plans are sought in the cave, and in combat he uses fire nova totem and chain lightning.
Ripp is a named beast in Outland. Its combat behavior includes attacking and fleeing for help.
Feng is a named beast in Outland. Its combat behavior includes attacking and fleeing for help.
Vacillating Voidcaller is a demonic creature. Its combat responses include absorbing fire energy and casting Elemental Response when summoned; when badly wounded, it can cast De-Materialize.
Amilya Airheart is a named Wind Rider Master. Her greeting is a call for guards, and her combat behavior includes summoning an enraged wyvern.
Mondul is a named Food & Drink vendor.
Lukra is a named General Goods vendor.
Hagash the Blind is a bowyer who sells goods and repairs equipment. A recorded retort identifies him as blind and shows his irritation when someone mistakes his blindness for deafness.
Peon Bolgar is a trade-goods vendor serving the Horde settlement at Thrallmar. His peon title and trade-goods specialty mark him as a local supplier.
The Wounded Stormwind Infantry are injured soldiers of Stormwind's Alliance force. Their wounds distinguish them from ordinary infantry.
Void Spawner L is a void creature that casts Nether Charge while out of combat.

Emissary Mordiba seeks to enlist the Unyielding spirits for the Horde's cause, recognizing that their hatred leaves them unwilling to listen. She proposes using force to make them join, hoping to gain undying soldiers against the Horde's enemies; she only expects they may become willing to hear her offer after feeling the Horde's strength.

An aging researcher obsessed with the Void, Ogath has spent years searching Outland for its secrets. His experimental warp-rift generator probes voidwalkers and their soul shards; dismissed as insane, he remains intent on unlocking the abyss’s power and says he will command it.
A Bonechewer evoker aligned with Spinebreaker, it attacks outsiders with shouted threats of death and bone-devouring.

Althen the Historian is an undead scholar who has studied ancient history through his un-life. He reads the Unyielding’s book as a record of the Armory’s past and later events, and believes understanding that history may help persuade the spirits to join the fight. He also sees their battle horn as a way to summon them and give some a chance at the vengeance they seek.

Manni is one of the peons taken from Foreman Razelcraz’s mine by fel orcs. After being rescued, Manni jokes with relief that it was almost dinner time, suggesting the captors had made the danger feel immediate.
Moh is one of the peons taken from Foreman Razelcraz’s mine by fel orcs. After being rescued, Moh says they thought they were done for, conveying how dangerous the captivity seemed.
Jakk is one of the peons taken from Foreman Razelcraz’s mine by fel orcs. Jakk is bitter about returning to work for Razelcraz, whom they call a slave master, but still thanks their rescuer.
Mixie Farshot is a gun merchant who sells guns.

Commander Hogarth is an undead commander of the Expedition Armory, one of the spirits known as the Unyielding. He remembers their defeat by the fel orcs and treats restoring their lost honor as a hard-won cause. The deaths at the siege tower remain present in his thoughts, and he honors those who oppose the Unyielding’s enemies.

Magister Aledis is a guarded confidant of Arelion. When pressed about Arelion’s affair, he first refuses to betray his friend, then pleads for his life and agrees to reveal the secret. His willingness to talk comes only after the confrontation turns against him.
Dagz is a named demon.

Fei Fei is Tracy’s faithful hound, a dog who searches for a place to hide his treats. He digs, sniffs around and keeps looking when a hiding spot does not satisfy him; a doggy treat makes him bark happily as he claims his new treasure.

Pestle is a Stormwind man who joined the military despite his brothers' advice against it, and sounds pleased he did. At Shatter Point he serves as supply officer, handling general goods and repairs; Gryphongar points queasy visitors his way for motion sickness help.

Gryphongar commands the Wildhammer outfit based at Shatter Point, a rough staging post for sorties into Hellfire. He directs air operations, sending newcomers on bombing runs against the Legion's production sites and onward to Honor Point for orders. His manner is brisk and wry: he praises capable flying, urges crews to stay ready, and jokes about the shaky outpost.

Runetog is a Wildhammer dwarf and gryphon master at Shatter Point, where he enjoys spending time in the air. He greets visitors with a joke about the floating outpost's queasiness and occasional flips. Gryphongar praises him as a fine dwarf who keeps his gryphons fit for battle, and Runetog provides flight service from the outpost.

A Wildhammer dwarf gryphoneer at Shatter Point, Windbellow relishes the time he gets in the air. He offers flights to Honor Point and the Abyssal Shelf, and has proved himself capable on repeated sorties over the Shelf. His work keeps him close to the Alliance foothold’s air operations in Hellfire Peninsula.

Leafbeard is a gryphoneer at Shatter Point. He reassures visitors that the base is sturdy, while advising them to be ready to escape by gryphon if it begins to fall apart. He also arranges the flight from the beachhead to Shatter Point, connecting the outpost with the coast of Hellfire Peninsula.
An Honor Hold gryphon rider serving in Hellfire Peninsula, one of several riders stationed in the area.
An Honor Hold scout in Hellfire Peninsula. This scout is shown practicing ranged attacks against an archery target, suggesting routine weapons training for the garrison’s scouts.
An Honor Hold defender stationed in the Hellfire Peninsula area.

Morod is one of the Dreghood elders held captive under Illidari rule. He says the winds have stopped speaking to his people, leaving them lost without elders to bring the spirits to them. In a response to his release, he says the winds speak to the tribe again and thanks the stranger who freed him.

Akoru is a Dreghood elder held captive under Illidari rule. He says his chains keep him from bringing the spirit of fire to his people, and that souls without fire cannot rebel against their masters. In a response to his release, he says he will ask fire to return and give his people courage to fight.

Aylaan is a Dreghood elder held captive under Illidari rule. She says the spirit of water has left her people and calls the tribe doomed. In a response to her release, she says water returns with the wisdom they need to survive the harsh land, and tells her rescuer she is in their debt.

Field Marshal Brock is an Alliance field commander at Honor Point, coordinating strikes against the Legion’s Forge Camps and invasion point. He asks for help despite the danger to Thrallmar, calling the Horde defenders allies, and praises a fighter who risks themself for former enemies as showing the honor and commitment that hold the Alliance together.
Razorsaw is the master of the Gan’arg Servants at Forge Camp: Mageddon, where the Legion is constructing Fel Reavers. In combat, Razorsaw uses Slime Spray and Saw Blade.

Corporal Ironridge serves at Expedition Point in the campaign against the Legion and Bleeding Hollow. He considers the outpost critical to Honor Hold's defense and says the campaign is short on able bodies. The talismans of fallen soldiers sadden him, while successful strikes hearten him; he seeks to weaken the Bleeding Hollow at Zeth'Gor. He also reports that his commanding officer, Colonel Jules, has suffered demonic corruption.
At Zeth'Gor, the Eye of the Citadel speaks in a deep, bone-chilling voice, calling intruders its playthings and threatening them with the orcs in its citadel.

Magister Bloodhawk is a blood elf magister in Thrallmar who can decipher Legion writing and identify threats in the Peninsula. He directs an effort against terrorfiends gathering near the Pools of Aggonar, and his dialogue praises capable help while showing interest in the recruit’s progress.

Dumphry is Honor Hold’s master blacksmithing trainer, a practical smith trying to stretch scarce supplies by salvaging usable metal and timber. He also takes on work requiring fel iron and other materials. Blunt about security, he distrusts the Horde’s armed presence and argues that weapons aimed at the Hold make their bearers enemies.

Vurtok Axebreaker is a Horde commander at Thrallmar, where he directs a mission against the Bonechewer orcs. Their demonic corruption and kinship with the Horde fuel his fury; he wants their blood collected so Apothecary Zelana can investigate how they became tainted. His report on the samples is openly angry, lamenting that more Bonechewers did not die.

Apothecary Zelana is a field researcher at Reaver's Fall, studying the blood of Outland's corrupted peoples. She seeks to understand the Bonechewers' demonic taint and examines samples gathered for her by Vurtok Axebreaker. Her tests confirm the Bonechewer blood is demonic, but her equipment cannot reveal more; for a separate Bleeding Hollow sample, she relies on her colleague Apothecary Albreck at Spinebreaker Post. She says she serves the Horde and is curious about the Bonechewers' strength.

At Spinebreaker Post, Apothecary Albreck studies Bleeding Hollow blood and the fel-orc affliction, using specialized equipment unavailable to his colleague Zelana at Reaver's Fall. He welcomes samples for testing, continues his own research, and prepares findings for fellow apothecary Antonivich. His dry remark about his long-clotted blood gives his scientific work a wry edge.

Megzeg Nukklebust is a goblin mercenary working for Thrallmar, where he helps repair fortifications and make explosives. He recruits help to salvage wood and metal from the Path of Glory and to burn Alliance cannons threatening Horde defenses. Resourceful with poor materials and delighted by the work, he jokes about turning bent, burnt scrap into precision explosives and praises a recruit's eye for trash.
A Floating Skull in Hellfire Peninsula.
Scarab Bunny is a named creature in Hellfire Peninsula.
A fel guard hound is a demonic guard beast. Its name and role identify a functional creature, rather than a person with a distinct public identity.
An Alliance gryphon guard post is an aerial security unit used across Hellfire Peninsula. Its name identifies its Alliance air-force role as a guard post, rather than a named individual.

An Alliance rooftop trip wire is a field security device deployed among Hellfire Peninsula sites. Its name identifies the rooftop variant and air-force role: a functional warning measure, rather than a named individual.

An Alliance ground trip wire is a field security device deployed among Hellfire Peninsula sites. Its name identifies the ground variant and air-force role: a functional warning measure, rather than a named individual.

Captain Darkhowl is a Horde captain associated with Spinebreaker Post. He treats the Bleeding Hollow clan's demonic pact as a betrayal of orcish heritage, urging the burning of Zeth'Gor and offering a bounty for Worg Master Kruush, whose riders prey on supply trains to the post. His words relish vengeance against the clan and its worg riders.
Reagan Mancuso is a gem vendor in Hellfire Peninsula. Visitors can browse his goods, and his vendor services include repairs.
Markus Scylan is a gem vendor in Hellfire Peninsula. Visitors can browse his goods, and his vendor services include repairs.

Zezzak is an orc researcher at Spinebreaker Post, drawn to mysteries of the orcs’ past and future. He studies Grillok’s enchanted eye and eyepatch, hoping to understand the warlock’s demonic ties and the Bleeding Hollow’s fall to demons. His interest is investigative and ominous.
An Incandescent Fel Spark is a fel creature found in Hellfire Peninsula. In combat it casts Fel Fireball; when it dies, it casts Living Flare Master.

Assistant Klatu serves in Honor Hold under Anchorite Barada and is involved in efforts to save Colonel Jules from a curse acquired near Gor'gaz Outpost. He says Barada is preparing an exorcism and asks for help gathering prayer beads and using an anchorite relic to free fel spirits. Klatu admits he lost his beads in the courtyard and suspects Fei Fei buried them; he is saddened by the violence the rescue requires, but hopeful for Jules.

Anchorite Barada is a solemn servant of the Light whose services in Honor Hold he performs with pride. He leads the attempt to cleanse Colonel Jules's demonic corruption, relying on prayer beads and an assistant for the ritual. During the struggle he invokes the Light as his guide and strength, urging Jules to be cleansed while admitting that he must not falter.

Colonel Jules is an officer at Honor Hold whose body is afflicted by demonic corruption. During Barada's attempted exorcism, the hostile voice speaking through him threatens the anchorite, mocks his helper and insists that Jules is beyond saving. In a line attributed to him, he describes the darkness lifting and his sight returning, then recognizes his savior.

Fel Cannon MKI is a demonic artillery weapon positioned at Forge Camp: Rage, where Field Marshal Brock says the guns are aimed at Thrallmar. He calls for three cannons to be destroyed to help keep the Horde outpost standing.

Magistrix Seyla is focused on stopping Legion reinforcements to Kael'thas: she created a living flare to destroy the gateway and says that if demons rebuild it, they will have to destroy it again. She speaks sharply of Kael's empowered former followers, calling them a disgrace, while dismissing Theris's worry about her as secondary to the greater danger. Her warnings show practical awareness of the Legion's forces around the gate.
The Hellfire Peninsula Flame Warden represents the Alliance's Midsummer fire observance in Hellfire. The Warden urges visitors to honor Alliance fires and desecrate Horde fires.

A festival attendant at the Hellfire Peninsula flame, this keeper invites visitors to honor it and speaks for the Horde's festival fires, encouraging observance at Horde settlements and desecration of Alliance flames.

A Summer Scorchling is an emissary to the elemental spirits of fire who accompanies Flame Wardens near Alliance settlements for the Midsummer festival. It eagerly devours summer incense and revels in its energy. Its grand claim to be Ragnaros's herald and threats give it a boastful air, softened when it admits it was jesting.
